Name: Arbor

With Arbor’s automated Product Carbon Footprinting (PCF) platform, you can quickly compute carbon footprints across the full lifecycle of your products.
• Hotspot Analysis: See a breakdown of which materials, suppliers, components or activities are contributing the most to your emissions
• Product Prototyping: Test product designs to reduce emissions strategically

Supercharge your climate strategy and measure your emissions with Arbor.

Name: XDI (Cross Dependency Initiative)
Description:
Our goal is to accelerate action on climate change by embedding physical climate risk data in all decisions.

As the physical climate risk experts, we’re here to help you - whether at the start of your journey, or advanced, we deliver actionable results.

We’re independent.

XDI is part of The Climate Risk Group, a group of companies committed to quantifying and communicating the costs of climate change.

We’re serious about climate.

Ours is a mission-driven company.
We exist to help our clients and community understand and manage unavoidable climate change, whilst demonstrating the imperative for a low carbon world.  

We see every contract as a collaboration. We are trusted by governments, NGOs, companies, banks and communities  - and while some see themselves in opposite corners - we believe it will take all actors working together to solve this challenge.

We’ve got heart

Data and information alone do not create change: data needs humanity and humanity needs ambition.
Our vision is not just to identify physical climate risks, but to also mitigate them.
Our goal is a more climate-resilient community.
Our approach is to work with you over the course of your climate risk journey.

Name: ClimateFirst Building Solutions
Description:
Your asset was designed for yesterday's climate.  It's time to adapt.

Developed by the climate and performance engineers at RWDI, ClimateFirst software models climate impacts against individual building systems for more accurate accounting. Its in-depth analysis goes beyond the general climate-data scanning tools to deliver actionable guidance for long-term resiliency.

 Meet ESG targets and simplify reporting.

Name: Resiliocs Intelligence
Description: Resiliocs is an AI-powered climate risk intelligence platform built for asset owners, institutional investors, and insurers managing climate-exposed portfolios. We move beyond static risk maps and generic scores to deliver layered, engineering-grade insights that quantify financial impact and tell you exactly what to do about it, identifying the highest-return adaptation strategies so you can avoid losses, invest smarter, and protect what matters. Because adaptation isn't a cost - it's a capital allocation decision.

Name: ÁCARA CLIMATE
Description:
ÁCARA CLIMATE is a risk management platform for making informed decisions about sustainable lending and sustainable investment in agriculture. It empowers financial institutions to understand climate risks within their agricultural portfolios and aids compliance with financial disclosure standards. Our climate physical risks management software predicts crop yields and losses across various timescales, regions, and crop types. It quantifies the financial impact of climate change on agriculture and recommends sustainable risk mitigation strategies.

Our proprietary model and dataset adhere to international regulatory standards and frameworks, ensuring robustness and reliability (aligned with UNEP-FI, IFRS-ISSB, and TCFD).

Name: SKYFOREST (an EarthDaily Analytics Company)
Description:
SkyForest Inc., is an an EarthDaily Analytics Company.

Long-term projections dictate that this trend will continue to impact our communities. Data is key to understanding how to minimize and estimate potential damages from wildfires. SkyForest's wildfire data is precise; providing 10-20 metre resolution that enables detailed risk assessment resulting in improved data for insurance, engineering, and utilities infrastructure.

Planet Watch Online Library offers FREE Access to Global Climate Resources

Name: Toronto Climate Observatory
Description:
The Toronto Climate Observatory (TCO) is an emerging interdisciplinary initiative hosted at the University of Toronto. Our mission is to reimagine how communities around the Greater Toronto Area (GTA) understand and adapt to the impacts of climate change, and support place-based, plural, and just climate action. 

Through partnerships with scholars, the government and civil society, we are working to develop the next generation of climate informatics. We draw inspiration and methods from climate modeling, human centered design, Science and Technology Studies (STS), Indigenous scholarship, oral history, citizen science, and art/science collaboration. Though our focus in on the Toronto area, our work spans many geographies and seeks to bring those lessons home wherever possible.


We are a new and expanding community of researchers from many areas and career stages. We are currently looking to expand our partnerships with other climate change scholars working in the GTA, as well as governments, community organizations, artists, and academic researchers so please get in touch if you’d like to learn more.

Name: SkyScout AI
Description: SkyScout fuses Earth Observation data to predict catastrophic risk across natural and urban ecosystems — pinpointing precisely where the risks of concern are located, weeks or months in advance, so operators can act to prevent wildfires and other catastrophic events, and protect critical infrastructure, biodiverse ecosystems, communities, and people.

Name: Traverse Analytics Inc.
Description:
Traverse Analytics is an operational resilience intelligence company that helps organizations anticipate disruption, strengthen readiness, and make faster, more informed decisions in complex environments. Through its flagship platform, ResiliSight, Traverse Analytics transforms climate, environmental, infrastructure, social vulnerability, and operational data into actionable intelligence that supports mission continuity, public safety, and organizational resilience.

As climate-related disasters, infrastructure failures, and operational disruptions become more frequent and interconnected, organizations face an overwhelming volume of data but often lack the tools needed to convert that information into clear action. Traverse Analytics addresses this challenge by integrating disparate data sources into a unified intelligence platform that delivers impact-based insights and decision support.

ResiliSight enables users to assess risk, monitor operational readiness, analyze historical incidents, evaluate infrastructure vulnerabilities, and identify emerging threats before they escalate into major disruptions. The platform applies advanced geospatial analytics, predictive modeling, and decision logic to generate meaningful recommendations such as resource pre-positioning, route adjustments, readiness escalation, and operational go/no-go decisions.

Traverse Analytics serves public safety organizations, municipalities, Indigenous communities, educational institutions, industrial operators, critical infrastructure owners, and defense and national security organizations. Its solutions support a wide range of use cases including disaster preparedness, critical infrastructure resilience, emergency management, logistics and mobility planning, climate security, and command and coordination. 

The company is building the intelligence layer that enables organizations to proactively manage risk, protect critical operations, build stronger, safer, and more resilient communities.

Name: TerraKora AI
Description:
TerraKora AI is building Africa’s trusted carbon verification infrastructure to unlock market-grade climate finance.
We combine advanced machine learning, geospatial data, and sovereign partnerships to create transparent, verifiable carbon measurement systems designed for national and regional adoption.

Our mission is to enable African nations to measure, verify, and monetize their natural capital with the same accuracy and credibility as global standards while keeping ownership and value creation at home.

 Through our AlphaKappaTM methodology, we integrate rigorous mathematics, multi-dimensional satellite data, AI-based models, and on-ground validation to quantify emissions reductions and carbon stock changes in near real-time for predictive power. The result is a scalable, Article 6.2 aligned MRV platform that supports governments, carbon funds, and private investors in building a credible, investable carbon ecosystem.

 Our technology integrates a fusion of optical, radar, and LiDAR data from the world’s leading Earth-observation satellites (including Sentinel-1 & 2, Landsat-8/9, and NASA spaceborne LiDAR missions) through advanced geospatial AI to deliver high-resolution, transparent, and sovereign-ready forestry carbon intelligence.

 We are laying the groundwork for Africa’s first sovereign carbon verification infrastructure with initial focus on Côte d’Ivoire to help nations issue, trade, and manage verified credits directly through compliant, data-driven registries.

Our focus areas:
• AI-driven carbon verification and monitoring
• National and regional carbon registries
• Climate finance market infrastructure
• Data transparency and sovereign carbon accounting

 Vision:
To redefine how the world measures, verifies, and values Africa’s natural capital to create the foundation for a new, equitable era of climate finance.

Name: NOAH Intelligence Inc.

Name: INVENT AI Ltd.
Description:

Name: GreenNudge
Description:
At GreenNudge, we're rethinking how manufacturers adopt climate solutions—making the process frictionless, data-driven, and finance-focused.

We enable industrial manufacturers to set meaningful climate goals using focused decarbonization pathways. Built for lean teams, our platform removes complexity from decarbonization through our scenario-planning 'Nudge' engine. We collect facility- and equipment-level Scope 1 & 2 emissions data, calculate product-level embedded emissions, and draw actionable reduction scenarios.

Capital decisions should be made with clarity, not guesswork. Our AI-powered platform also revolutionizes sustainable procurement. We help manufacturers evaluate the business case for sustainable sourcing, automate supplier discovery and communication, and seamlessly integrate sustainable alternatives into operations. Whether sourcing sustainable cotton or decarbonizing production lines, we connect strategy to execution.

What We Solve:

We're trusted by industrial manufacturers across energy, textile, and manufacturing to hit climate targets while improving bottom-line performance.

Name: LivingWithWater
Description:
Living with Water (LWW) brings together a diverse, multidisciplinary team of researchers and solution seekers to support human and more-than-human communities living along British Columbia’s South Coast to prepare and adapt for sea level rise and the cascading effects of flooding.

The team of researchers are from the University of British Columbia (UBC), Simon Fraser University (SFU), the University of Waterloo (UW), Wageningen University & Research (WUR), and West Coast Environmental Law (WCEL) in partnership with First Nations governments, and decision-makers from various levels of government in B.C.

The project is funded by the Pacific Institute for Climate Solutions through its Theme Partnership Program. Theme projects involve interdisciplinary teams of researchers and climate solution seekers (from the private and public sectors) working together on thematic areas of high complexity and high impact – from project outset, to results-implementation. These projects generate new knowledge, build international leadership within British Columbia’s research community, and help drive further innovation in critical thematic areas.

Name: Constellia
Description:
We used to treat climate risk as a problem to solve. Today it’s a problem to live with—and to prepare for. Floods, extreme heat and wildfires are arriving faster and in unexpected places, and coarse, regional warnings aren’t giving people the context they need to act.

In Newfoundland in May 2025, the provincial dashboard reported low fire risk even after more than half the year’s average fires had already occurred. That kind of mismatch erodes trust and leaves communities exposed.

Constellia closes that gap with hyperlocal sensing and real-time forecasting. Inspired by our founder’s combined experience in quantitative finance and electrical engineering, we developed an integrated platform of rugged, low‐power sensors, edge processing, and cloud analytics that convert local environmental measurements into clear, actionable alerts. Deployable across neighborhoods, critical infrastructure, and vulnerable landscapes, our system delivers contextual warnings for flooding, wildfire, extreme heat, poor air quality and more—designed for emergency managers and everyday residents.

We partner with municipalities, utilities, and community organizations to design tailored deployments and rapid pilots that prioritize high-risk assets and populations. Contact us to explore a pilot or deployment that strengthens your community’s resilience.

Name: Rivéo
Description:
Dans le cadre de notre projet de fin d'études à l'Université de Sherbrooke, nous développons une station de télémétrie conçue pour l'analyse de rivière en environnements isolés. Notre solution répond à trois enjeux critiques :

1. Optimisation hydroélectrique : Mesure continue du débit pour affiner les modèles de prédiction de production des barrages.

2. Prévention des inondations : Détection automatique du couvert de glace par analyse caméra pour anticiper la formation d’embâcles et les risques d'innondations.

3. Versatilité dans tous les milieux : Système non invasif (sans contact) réduisant l’entretien et les bris liés aux débris ou à la glace, pensé pour résister aux hivers québecois.

Équipe multidisciplinaire (8 étudiants) :

Robotique (2) : Conception mécanique et intégration de systèmes.
Électrique (3) : Gestion énergétique et acquisition de données capteurs.
Informatique (3) : Algorithmes de vision par ordinateur et API/serveur.
